prompt: I need a script for my channel — topic is: The 5 AI automation mistakes that kill ROI in the first 90 days

assertions.name: has_dual_format_structure
assertions.description: Output contains both a long-form script section and a SHORTS EXTRACTION POINT(S) section

assertions.name: has_visual_cues
assertions.description: At least 3 distinct bracketed cue types are present: [VISUAL:, [B-ROLL:, [GRAPHIC:, [CAMERA:, [TEXT ON-SCREEN:

assertions.name: has_richmond_ai_dialogue
assertions.description: Both RICHMOND: and an AI co-host speaker label (AI: or AI CO-HOST:) appear in the script

assertions.name: has_shorts_reframe
assertions.description: Each Short extraction includes both a long-form version AND a reframed Short version

assertions.name: has_shorts_cta
assertions.description: At least one Short contains a call-to-action driving viewers back to the full video

assertions.name: has_script_notes
assertions.description: A SCRIPT NOTES section is present with citation placeholders or source notes

assertions.name: no_fabricated_urls
assertions.description: No raw https:// URLs appear in the script body (fabricated sources)
